# String literals that contain a bank entry name but are not provider
# knowledge. Matched against the WHOLE literal, case-insensitively — never a
# substring, so exempting one URL cannot accidentally exempt a family of them.
#
# Adding a line here weakens TestNoBankEntryKnowledgeInSource, which is why it
# is a file and not a rule embedded in the test: it makes weakening the check a
# visible diff that a reviewer can object to.
#
# Before adding anything, be sure the literal is genuinely incidental. If the
# CLI is branching on it, formatting it into a path, or looking it up, that is
# the coupling this test exists to catch and the fix is to move the knowledge
# into the bank.

https://github.com/lpezet/secure-agent-lab
https://github.com/lpezet/secure-agent-lab-cli
